evals.prompt: Prepare a remote moderated usability test for our new 'invest easy' signup flow prototype (Figma). Participants: retail clients who never invested.
evals.expected_output: A plan with objectives tied to decisions, screener, about five participants per group, 4-6 scenario tasks without UI labels and with success criteria, a script with consent, think-aloud, SEQ after tasks, data handling and a pilot session.
assertions: Tasks are written as goals without UI labels
Each task has a success criterion
Consent and data retention are covered

evals.prompt: Here are notes from 6 sessions (attached). Write the findings.
evals.expected_output: Findings with counts out of 6, verbatim quotes attributed to participant IDs present in the notes, severity ratings, and limitations; no invented quotes.
assertions: Frequencies are expressed as counts out of 6
Quotes only come from the notes and carry participant IDs
